task1.title: Annual rainfall in four cities
task1.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the average annual rainfall (in millimetres) in four cities.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

task1.title: Internet users in a country, 2000-2020
task1.prompt:
The line graph below shows the number of internet users (in millions) in a country between 2000 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Working from home
task2.prompt:
Some people believe that working from home is more productive and better for employees, while others think it harms teamwork and career development.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Write at least 250 words.

task2.title: Plastic waste
task2.prompt:
Plastic waste is one of the most serious environmental problems facing the world today.

What problems does plastic waste cause, and what measures could governments and individuals take to reduce it?

Write at least 250 words.

task2.title: Living abroad
task2.prompt:
An increasing number of people choose to live and work in a foreign country for a period of time.

Do the advantages of living abroad outweigh the disadvantages?

Write at least 250 words.

task1.title: Letter of complaint
task1.prompt:
You recently stayed at a hotel and were unhappy with your experience.

Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter:
- describe the problems you experienced
- explain how these problems affected your stay
- say what you would like the manager to do

Write at least 150 words.
